question: Does the fixed scene-only Qwen3 4B predictor improve probability forecasts of human virtual exit choices?
accuracy_threshold: p_left >= 0.5 predicts left, matching the historical benchmark
inference: 34 fresh stateless requests; no reuse of the six no-prior diagnostic responses; no outcome fields in input
prompt_and_options: Use the exact system prompt and inference settings frozen in the prior-mechanism probe. Remove training_base_probability_left from each historical scene.
invalid_output_policy: Keep raw errors and missing predictions; no fallback, repair calls or prompt tuning. Do not score the full comparison unless all 34 probabilities are valid.
development_visibility: Dataset structure and old outcomes already analyzed. Six scene-only predictions were inspected during the mechanism probe. This is not external confirmation.
secondary_subset: Report separately the remaining 28 conditions not selected for the prior-mechanism probe. This subset is still development data; it is not untouched confirmation.
diagnostic_overlap: Compare the six repeated identical scene-only requests against their earlier responses to describe output reproducibility; do not choose between responses.
inference_reporting: Descriptive paired comparisons only. Fixed treatment conditions, one new LLM probability per condition, no population significance claim or independent-sample count of 489 LLM responses.
decision_rule: If both condition-macro NLL and Brier improve over frequency, treat as a development signal for independent confirmation, not deployment. Also report rule and Logit comparisons regardless of outcome. If not, close this fixed 4B configuration without further prompt selection.
fairness_disclosure: Rules and Logit use other mirror families' human labels for calibration; the no-prior LLM sees only scene descriptions. Input scene information is shared, learning procedures are not identical.
historical_comparison_disclosure: Old prior-provided LLM differs by prior presence and one system sentence; do not attribute its entire score difference causally to removal alone.
